settings.name: pdpUrl
settings.description: The AuthZEN PDP's base URL for the grants and MCP servlets; /access/v1/evaluation is appended. Then AUTHZEN_BASE_URL; the shipped web.xml sets it (http://host.docker.internal:9099), so AUTHZEN_BASE_URL is never read unless web.xml is edited (F-0238). It must be https unless OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development: the PDP's answers decide every evaluation and its bearer token travels with each request

when_wrong.detail: Unset, or not an http or https URL: the servlet does not start. http under the production profile: GM_API is FAILED_CONFIG, the reason naming pdpUrl, and its endpoints answer 503

settings.name: pdpToken
settings.description: The bearer token sent to a protected PDP; then AUTHZEN_BEARER_TOKEN

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: the PDP refuses every evaluation

settings.name: audience
settings.description: The aud this API answers to, the access token manager's audience claim; then GM_AUDIENCE; the shipped web.xml sets it, so GM_AUDIENCE is never read unless web.xml is edited (F-0238)

when_wrong.detail: Unset: the servlet does not start; wrong, every token is a 401

settings.name: pdpTimeoutMs
settings.description: How long the grants and MCP servlets wait for the PDP

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the servlet does not start

settings.name: issuer
settings.description: The issuer the metadata servlet advertises; unset, none is

settings.name: grantManagementEndpoint
settings.description: The grant_management_endpoint the metadata servlet advertises; <request base>/gm-api/grants when unset

when_wrong.detail: Not an http or https URL: the metadata servlet does not start, naming it; otherwise advertised as written
